subject.title: Hide unlimited Copilot Chat quota bars

question: Should explicitly unlimited Copilot Chat quota be omitted entirely, remain represented as a zero-used meter, or be displayed as a distinct non-metered Unlimited status?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it intentionally reverses a behavior documented and shipped in v0.33.0; source inspection cannot determine which presentation policy maintainers now want.

options.title: Show Unlimited status
options.body: Preserve the entitlement as a non-metered “Chat: Unlimited” row and omit progress and reset visuals.

options.title: Hide unlimited quotas
options.body: Approve this PR’s omission behavior as an intentional reversal of the v0.33.0 presentation policy.

options.title: Keep shipped behavior
options.body: Retain the visible zero-used Chat lane and close or pause this PR unless stronger evidence supports changing it.

recommendation.title: Show Unlimited status
recommendation.body: Preserve the entitlement as a non-metered “Chat: Unlimited” row and omit progress and reset visuals.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes a recently shipped Copilot presentation policy and is best owned by the repository’s release integrator with recent provider history.
